$comment: Parity ledger between pi-dsh and DeepSeek Harness. pi-dsh is a semantic reimplementation, so drift is tracked explicitly: run `npm run check:drift -- [path-to-deepseek-harness]` to list upstream commits since the pin that touch mapped packages, review them, then bump dsh.commit (the script's --update-pin does this after your review). Status values: ported | partial | not-ported | not-applicable.

areas.notes: A pi-dsh addition. DSH keeps durable user instructions in AGENTS.md (agent-instructions) and in its LLM-written checkpoint ('Critical Context'). pi-vcc compacts algorithmically and can drop a rule list, so rules_write stores them as session entries and re-injects them in the control section after every compaction.

Repeat reminders 3/5/8; read-before-edit + stale-version; tool deadlines: timeout input caps on all tools, fused AbortSignal deadlines for nested executeTool calls, configurable top-level watchdog (toolTimeoutMs) that aborts and stamps TOOL_TIMEOUT. DSH timeout-policy is likewise cooperative (it cannot hard-stop a tool that ignores exec.signal); the residual Pi gap is that a model-issued foreign call's signal cannot be swapped per-call, so top-level enforcement aborts the turn, not just the call.

Sandbox: bubblewrap profile + escalation approval + cached functional probe + sandboxRunnerCommand override (DSH runnerCommand). DSH Linux fallback Landlock runner is not ported; bubblewrap only, fails closed.

Backends: node-pty, util-linux script, and tmux for durable=true. Durable tmux terminals survive a pi exit and reattach on restore; all terminals persist a transcript, and dead non-durable terminals restore as exited stubs (shell state cannot be resurrected). pwsh tools register only when a binary exists.

Tree-wide capacity (8), maxSubagentDepth (default 1) with child-visible delegation tools below the cap, adjacent messaging both directions with messageIds, per-child model/thinking/preset selection, timeouts, progress/activity via agent_status, descriptor-persisted catalog (result replay + cold resume after restart), and the agent-team board (CAS revisions, blockedBy readiness, writeScope overlap warnings, wait-for-change) visible to teammates as scoped tools. Deltas: presets are pi-dsh config objects, not DSH preset-registry compositions; interrupt waits for settle instead of returning on acceptance; child bash is stock Pi bash (no owned jobs/sandbox in children); team state is one board per root session persisted as session entries.
Also list_subagent_models. Children run through the Pi SDK only.
Plus a mossbed backend with no DSH equivalent.

DSH ships web/desktop React panels. A Pi extension can draw footer status + string-array widgets, so pi-dsh renders goal/todos/jobs/agents-terminals-team widgets and a /dsh dashboard instead (src/ui.ts). No clickable panels, no graphs.

dsh-sandbox-ssh confines processes launched by DSH's SSH subprocess/filesystem providers through a remote helper. pi-dsh has no SSH transport to confine; porting the sandbox without an SSH execution feature would be dead code. Local bubblewrap is the applicable boundary.
Out of scope by maintainer decision: pi-dsh is Linux-tested.
